prior_threads.reason: Dr. Uriah carries the map and plans to copy it, the party means to check a marked location on the way north, and Father William added marks to it. The treasure is still unfound.

The question of what the Clurichen does is answered: Naggeneen drinks Quinn's booze (beat_18). He is now captive in a bag behind Quinn's bar (beat_19, beat_37), and his offer of a pot of gold or a secret still stands, so the situation remains open in a new shape.

George revealed where the lair is (beat_58), and the danger has escalated because the dragon will soon fly. The party learned the dragon can only be killed with Brandon's sword (beat_51), and George doubts the Reeve has the bounty (beat_60). The dragon is still alive.
Hilda was only seen in passing. Sir Phidipaldi's promise to return for her services is unreleased.
Ned was only seen in passing, and his offer remains undecided.
Shipments still had not come in, and the cause is still unknown.
Phidipaldi still scorns Eric as a man of no honor. Nothing shows the duel happened or was declined.
Gill is willing to go lower than his price and would drop it once his boys return, but no deal for the mule is made yet.
Dunk confirmed the shirt is magical, scouted Warwick's house and has a plan to get it, but he does not have it yet.
The thief turned out to be Naggeneen, not Bentley (beat_18), and Quinn paid the party for catching him (beat_19). Nothing remains owed or unknown.

new_threads.name: Squints and Trout's Halfling Corps
new_threads.reason: Trout recruited Squints on stated terms, including picks after the first treasure, and that arrangement is ongoing. Trout's secret intent not to rescue him also belongs to this relationship.

new_threads.name: Ingrid's sleeping potion for Warwick
new_threads.reason: Dunk's bargain with Ingrid is one deal: he supplies the faun wine and helps her dose Warwick, she makes the potion, and he holds her secret. Dunk stated it serves his plan to get Warwick's armor (beat_33, beat_44). The potion is not yet made, and they are to meet tonight.

new_threads.name: Sir Brandon's magic sword at the Barrow Mound
new_threads.reason: Father William says the dragon can't be killed without the sword buried with Brandon (beat_51), so this serves the dragon hunt. The party is heading to the Barrow, and Brother Dirk's willingness to continue is unsettled (beat_86).

new_threads.name: Dr. Uriah's penance and donation at the Barrow Mound
new_threads.reason: Uriah promised Father William penance at the Barrow Mound and a 10 gold donation for its upkeep. That promise is still owed.

new_threads.name: Why the hidden fairies are coming out
new_threads.reason: Ingrid reports that fairies which used to stay hidden are encroaching more often. This is an unexplained change that stands apart from the dragon.

new_threads.name: The giant in the cyclopean cottage
new_threads.reason: A man-eating giant on the road north woke as the party rescued Dirk, then chased them until he tired. Escaping him does not end the danger.

standalone_beats.reason: Ingrid's wares, including healing tea and magic-revealing witch powder, are a useful resource tied to no thread.
Father William offers to heal Uriah if he is injured, a resource tied to no thread.
Uriah bought essence of wolfsbane and mandrake root tea, which adds to the party's supplies.
